javax.microedition.broadcast.esg
Interface ServiceGuideListener

public interface ServiceGuideListener

ServiceGuideListener allows the application to monitor changes to ProgramEvent, Service and PurchaseObject information.

Events may be received per

  1. Individual program: NEW_PROGRAM_LISTED, PROGRAM_CHANGED and PROGRAM_DELETED
  2. Service: NEW_SERVICE_LISTED, SERVICE_CHANGED and SERVICE_DELETED.
  3. Purchase object: PURCHASE_OBJECT_ADDED, PURCHASE_OBJECT_CHANGED, PURCHASE_OBJECT_DELETED
An event may also signify global bulk changes to the ESG, as in SERVICE_GUIDE_BULK_CHANGED.

ServiceGuideListener is set via ServiceGuide.addListener. addListener allows a filter to be set. So not all change events will be propagated to the applications depending on the filtering criteria set.

Implementations use constants specified here to post the events. Applications can test the event by using "==" operator instead of String.equals() method.

PROGRAM_CHANGED

static final java.lang.String PROGRAM_CHANGED
Posted when the information on an existing program (denoted by the serviceGuideData parameter) is changed.

When this event is received, the eventData parameter will be an array of Attribute objects denoting the attributes that were changed.

Value "ProgramChanged" is assigned to PROGRAM_CHANGED.

PROGRAM_DELETED

static final java.lang.String PROGRAM_DELETED
Posted when an existing program (denoted by the serviceGuideData parameter) is about to be deleted. The application can still access the serviceGuideData when this event is received.

A program that has finished or occurred in the past will not generate a PROGRAM_DELETED event.

When this event is received, the eventData parameter will be null.

Value "ProgramDeleted" is assigned to PROGRAM_DELETED.

SERVICE_GUIDE_BULK_CHANGED

static final java.lang.String SERVICE_GUIDE_BULK_CHANGED
Posted when a large part of electronic service information is changed (bulk change). Instead of sending individual update events per program change, this event notifies the application of an event that updated a large part of the service information. In response to this event, the application should redo any queries to the program database that's needed to update the presentation of the services, for example. Individual NEW_PROGRAM_LISTED, PROGRAM_CHANGED, PROGRAM_DELETED, NEW_SERVICE_LISTED, SERVICE_CHANGED, SERVICE_DELETED, PURCHASE_OBJECT_ADDED, PURCHASE_OBJECT_CHANGED and PURCHASE_OBJECT_DELETED events will not be sent in response to this bulk change.

This event is delivered despite the possible filters set in ServiceGuide.addListener(ServiceGuideListener listener, Query filter)

When this event is received, the serviceGuideData and eventData parameters will be null.

Removal of data from the service guide about past program events does not cause this event to be delivered.

Value "ServiceGuideBulkChanged" is assigned to SERVICE_GUIDE_BULK_CHANGED.

See Also:
Constant Field Values

SERVICE_GUIDE_DELETED

static final java.lang.String SERVICE_GUIDE_DELETED
Posted when the underlying electronic service guide information has been deleted. Usually, the service guide information is deleted when platform provider is changed. Once this event is posted the specific ServiceGuide is no longer valid.

When this event is received, serviceGuideData and eventData parameters will be null

Value "ServiceGuideDeleted" is assigned to SERVICE_GUIDE_DELETED.

See Also:
Constant Field Values

SERVICE_GUIDE_UPDATE_COMPLETED

static final java.lang.String SERVICE_GUIDE_UPDATE_COMPLETED
Posted when the most recent electronic service information update is completed. This event must be preceded by a SERVICE_GUIDE_UPDATE_STARTED event. Application will be further notified of any program changes in response to this update event via the SERVICE_GUIDE_BULK_CHANGED event or the individual NEW_PROGRAM_LISTED, PROGRAM_CHANGED, PROGRAM_DELETED, NEW_SERVICE_LISTED, SERVICE_CHANGED, PURCHASE_OBJECT_ADDED, PURCHASE_OBJECT_CHANGED and PURCHASE_OBJECT_DELETED events.

When this event is received, the serviceGuideData and eventData parameters will be null.

Value "ServiceGuideUpdateCompleted" is assigned to SERVICE_GUIDE_UPDATE_COMPLETED.

See Also:
Constant Field Values

SERVICE_GUIDE_UPDATE_FAILED

static final java.lang.String SERVICE_GUIDE_UPDATE_FAILED
Posted when the update to the underlying electronic service guide information failed. The update may be triggered by the underlying implementation auto-updating the service information, or by the application directly calling ServiceGuide.forceUpdate(). The failure may be resulted from problems related to network coverage, for example.

When this event is received, serviceGuideData will be null and eventData will be a non-empty String stating the reason for the failure.

Value "ServiceGuideUpdateFailed" is assigned to SERVICE_GUIDE_UPDATE_FAILED.

See Also:
Constant Field Values

SERVICE_GUIDE_UPDATE_STARTED

static final java.lang.String SERVICE_GUIDE_UPDATE_STARTED
Posted when the underlying electronic service information is being updated. This could be triggered by the underlying implementation auto-updating the service information, or by the application directly calling ServiceGuide.forceUpdate().

A SERVICE_GUIDE_UPDATE_COMPLETED event will be received when the service guide update is completed; or SERVICE_GUIDE_UPDATE_FAILED will be received if the update failed.

When SERVICE_GUIDE_UPDATE_STARTED is received, it is not advisable for the applications to retrieve information from the database or programs since those information will not remain current after the ESG update.

When this event is received, the serviceGuideData and eventData parameters will be null.

Value "ServiceGuideUpdateStarted" is assigned to SERVICE_GUIDE_UPDATE_STARTED.

See Also:
